goal: Implement the booking flow and availability management.
summary: Phase 4 completed after grader fixes. Booking creation now records the reserved session time (preferredDate from Availability.startDateTime). The booking-details API is protected by an email query-parameter ownership check (400 missing, 401 mismatch, 404 not found). The booking form redirects with bookingId and email; the confirmation page passes email to the API. Added route-level tests for the API. Build, lint, and 84 tests pass.

  3. Create booking server action that checks availability atomically and creates a Booking record. Creates lib/actions/booking.ts. [verified]
  4. Add booking confirmation page. Creates app/[locale]/booking/confirmed/page.tsx. [verified]
